label: シールド

evidence: The value of the shield gained from Rubble Rouser is equal to 40% max HP + 600.

evidence: After 3s, any cotton leftover is used to restore the HP of teammates with cotton shields for 15% of the remaining shield value.

evidence: Fires a beam of energy toward the targeted enemy after a delay, dealing damage to all enemies that it hits, as well as additional damage based on their Max HP. The move changes Stages based on the number of stacks of Dragon Dance that Dragonite has, from 0 to 3. The max HP damage is 0%/6%/12%/18%, determined by the current Stage. Dragonite cannot act while releasing the beam. Against Wild Pokémon: The additional damage from max HP is capped at 600/1200/1800/2400 depending on the stage.

evidence: This Pokémon heals 15% of damage dealt with basic and boosted attacks.

evidence: The next auto attack gains additional healing by 3% of max HP. When using full sprint gauge attack the charge time for this move is additionally reduced by 1s.

label: HP回復（4つ目のマーク消費）

evidence: The fourth part of the mark deals increased additional damage and removes the mark when consumed, and the user restores 20% max HP.

evidence: Greedent eats a special berry to recover 15% max HP and then leaps to the designated area; dealing damage and throwing enemies within the area of effect for 1s.

label: 近距離攻撃の追加ダメージ

evidence: Auto attacks differ depending on range, and become boosted attacks with every third attack, dealing increased damage. Auto attacks used at long range reduce the cooldown of Bubble, Water Shuriken, or Surf by 0.5s when they hit. Boosted attacks used at long range also decrease the movement speed of the opposing Pokémon hit by 25% for 0.5s. Auto attacks used in close range instead deal a bonus 5% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit. Boosted attacks used in close range dash through the target, dealing a bonus 10% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit instead. Against wild Pokémon: the missing HP damage of auto attacks used in close range is capped at 500.

label: 追加の確定ダメージ

evidence: If the additional damage would bring an enemy Pokémon below 10% of their max HP, that enemy Pokémon will take 40% of their maximum HP as True Damage.

label: 回復（追撃の連続攻撃）
formula: 追撃の連続攻撃で実際に与えたダメージ×40%。
evidence: The user charges in the designated direction, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon for 0.5s. If the move hits, a follow up becomes available for 3s. When recast; the user leaps forward, an opposing Pokémon hit by the attack is barraged with 4 attacks, each stunning for 0.2s for up to a 0.8s duration, and restoring the user's health by 40% of the damage dealt. Against targets that cannot be stunned, only one instance of increased damage is dealt. This barrage will end early if the user inputs movement.

label: 回復（着地時）

evidence: Jump into the air, removing most statuses and becoming invincible. The moment Sylveon lands, lose invincibility and immediately gain Fairy Frolic buff, while dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and healing for 60% of the damage dealt. Fairy Frolic buff: for 10s, 50% of the damage dealt by Sylveon is converted into HP. No HP is recovered if the damage is dealt to shields. Against Wild Pokémon: Damage is capped at 2000.

label: 追加のHP吸収（進化後）
formula: サナギラスへの進化後、通常攻撃・強化攻撃で実際に与えたダメージ×5%を追加で回復します。ユナイトわざ中の通常攻撃や、確定ダメージにも適用されます。
evidence: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits. After evolving to Pupitar basic and boosted attacks (and basic attacks during Tyrannical Rampage) have an additional 5% lifesteal that is also active when doing true damage.

label: 追加の確定ダメージ
formula: 自分が凍らせた相手チームのポケモンへダメージを与え、その相手のHPが最大HPの10%未満のとき、相手の最大HP×15%を追加します。ダメージ軽減によりKOされない場合があります。
evidence: Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 10% max HP and frozen by Suicune deals an additional 15% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction can prevent the target from being knocked out). Using a move grants a shield for 5s (up to 2 times); separately increases the crystal gauge by 1 for 5s (becoming full when increased 2 times). Flooded areas created by Whirlpool or Surf remain for 5s; opposing Pokémon in a flooded area are marked as drenched for 3s. Freezing a flooded area with a regular move (not Unite Move) also freezes opposing Pokémon in that flooded area for 1s. Freezing an opposing Pokémon marked as drenched removes the mark; targets frozen by a regular move or by a frozen area cannot be marked as drenched for 3s afterward. Deals bonus damage when freezing opposing Pokémon with a regular move or by being in a frozen area.

label: 追加の確定ダメージ

evidence: Briefly becomes unstoppable and explodes with anger, then goes on a rampage for 10s, gaining 50% tenacity for the duration. While rampaging, changes the auto attack pattern, dealing increased damage. Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 20% max HP with these auto attacks deals 40% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction effects can prevent the target from being knocked out).

label: シールド
formula: 自分の最大HP×25%。シールドは2.5秒間で、障害物に当たるたび持続時間を更新します。
evidence: Wigglytuff gains a 25% max HP shield for 2.5s and rolls forwards. Wigglytuff becomes unstoppable for the duration of the roll, damaging and throwing Pokémon hit in the air for 0.5s. Hitting an obstacle while rolling will change the direction Wigglytuff is moving up to 5 times and reset the cooldown of Pound, Double Slap, and Dazzling Gleam. Also, the shield refreshes duration each time an obstacle is hit.

label: 回復（シールド終了時）

evidence: Begin performing a recital and become unstoppable for 3s, granting Wigglytuff and nearby allies a shield for 3.5s as well as removing all status conditions from Wigglytuff and the affected allies and granting them immunity to hindrances for as long as the shield is active. When the shield expires, allies are healed for 50% of the remaining shield value.

label: 追加の確定ダメージ・超過回復のシールド

evidence: When this Pokémon deals damage with boosted attacks or moves, a mark of destruction is applied onto opposing Pokémon. This mark lasts 3s and stacks up to 5 times, increasing Yveltal's damage towards the marked Pokémon by 2% per stack. When Yveltal hits a Pokémon on the opposing team with a move or boosted attack, if that Pokémon has 5 marks of destruction and is below 10% Max HP, Yveltal will additionally deal 40% of that Pokémon's Max HP as true damage (Effectively 44% Max HP due to the required 5 marks of destruction). Pokémon KO'd by this damage will heal Yveltal, any healing exceeding the user's Max HP will be converted into a shield for 3s, at a 50% conversion rate.

label: 回復・超過回復のシールド

evidence: The user launches a destructive beam in the designated direction, dealing damage and healing the user for 21% of the damage dealt. Against wild Pokémon the healing is reduced to 7%. Any leftover healing from the move that exceeds the user's max HP is converted into a shield at a 50% conversion (effects that alter healing directly are ignored). The shield lasts 2s, the duration is refreshed with each application, and can stack up to 10x. The maximum capacity of the shield is determined by the healing value of the most recent application.

label: 非戦闘時の回復（1秒ごと）

evidence: Umbreon briefly becomes unstoppable, leaping up and absorbing 50% of the shields from enemy Pokémon in an area around Umbreon, taking them for the user. Umbreon then lands, dealing damage to Pokémon in an area-of-effect, and stuns them for 1s. For 5s, enemy Pokémon in the area around Umbreon are slowed by 30%, and if an enemy Pokémon in that area is granted a shield, Umbreon absorbs 50% of the shield for themself. Additionally, after learning this move and while not in combat, Umbreon continually recovers 1% Max HP every second. Note: Umbreon cannot steal shields granted by Rayquaza or Assault Vest.

evidence: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage to enemies and heal for 5% max HP when this boosted attack hits.

label: 回復（ねむり中・1回分）

This Unite Move can be used again before the user snores a second time to flip over in the designated sideways direction and slam the ground, dealing an extra instance of snore damage in the area of effect and throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. While the user is fast asleep, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax. After the user flips over or snores a second time, the user can use this Unite Move again to stop sleeping early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal.

All other players heal from picking up an Oran berry for 2% Max HP + 5x(Level-1) + 45 (level and Max HP scaling is based on the player that ate the Oran berry).

evidence: Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to enemies hit equal to 0.5% of their remaining HP.  When crystals pass through wild Pokémon who are not the designated target, this additional damage is not applied. Against Wild Pokémon: This additional damage is capped at 300.

label: ダメージ（初撃・ためなし）
formula: 攻撃×32%＋（Lv−1）＋38。最初の波動1回分です。
evidence: Duraludon begins charging power, slowing itself by 30%. The longer the move is charged the greater the damage and area of effect. After learning this move a mark will be applied to any enemy Duraludon damages with auto attacks and moves. Each tick of damage from Duraludon (boosted attack counts as 1 instance) will apply 1 mark up to a maximum of 5 orbs and 1 ring. This mark lasts for 5s, is refreshed when Duraludon deals damage to the marked enemy and can be cleansed. When Dragon Pulse hits a marked enemy, the marks are consumed and additional damage is dealt for each mark. Opposing Duraludon's can consume the user's marks but will not gain the additional damage. Furthermore, if this move knocks out an enemy, the cooldown is reduced by 30% and Duraludon receives a buff for 8s or 3 auto attacks. While this buff is active, auto attacks deal additional damage and reduce this moves cooldown by 1.5s each.
